Design a simple experiment to demonstrate a key principle of 'Temperature and its Measurement'.

(b) Step-by-step Procedure.
(c) Expected Result & Conclusion.
questions.detailed_solution:
(a) Aim: To investigate the core phenomenon of Temperature and its Measurement.
Materials: Standard containers, measuring tools, test samples.
(b) Procedure: Set up controlled conditions, change one test variable, observe and record data.
(c) Conclusion: The experimental results confirm that the observed change directly depends on the controlled variable.

questions.question_text:
Analyze a situation where improper methods are used in studying 'Temperature and its Measurement'.
(a) Identify the error in methodology.
(b) Explain the potential consequence of this error.
(c) Suggest the correct scientific procedure.
questions.detailed_solution:
(a) Error: Failing to control background variables or using uncalibrated instruments.
(b) Consequence: Leads to inaccurate data, false conclusions, and unrepeatable results.
(c) Correct Procedure: Use calibrated tools, maintain strict control variables, and perform multiple trial runs.
